texts.preamble: Nazrul Haque @ Nazrul Islam And Anr vs The State Of Assam on 19 October, 2020 Author: Ajit Borthakur Bench: Ajit Borthakur Page N Gahc010125762020 The Gauhati High Court (High Court Of Assam, Nagaland, Mizoram And Arunachal Pradesh) Case No. : Ab 2416/2020 1:Nazrul Haque @ Nazrul Islam And Anr. S/O. Abdul Hussain, R/O. No.1 Batalimari, P.S. Bhuragaon, Dist. Morigaon, Assam. 2: Abdul Jalil S/O. Lt. Azgar Ali R/O. No.1 Batalimari P.S. Bhuragaon Dist. Morigaon Assam Versus 1:The State Of Assam Rep. By Pp, Assam. Advocate for the Petitioner : Md. S Huda Advocate for the Respondent : Pp, Assam Before Honourable Mr. Justice Ajit Borthakur Order Date : 19-10-2020
texts.facts: 1 This petition under Section 438 Cr.P.C., is filed for granting the privilege of pre-arrest bail to the petitioners, namely i) Nazrul Haque @ Nazrul Islam and ii) Abdul Jalil, apprehending arrest in connection with Bhuragaon P.S. Case No. 111/2020 registered Page No.# 2/2 u/s 272/269/426/420 of the IPC.
texts.arguments: Mr. S. Huda, learned counsel for the petitioners, submits that the F.I.R. itself is not maintainable under the provisions of the Indian Penal Code when there is special statute namely Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 to deal with the food adulterations and when the aforesaid Act authorises the Food Commissioner, Food Safety Officer and Food Inspector etc. to detect such offences and prosecute the offenders. Mr. D. Das, learned Addl. Public Prosecutor, submits that the case diary reveals prima facie incriminating material against the petitioners and in the backdrop of facts, it is not a fit case to grant the pre-arrest bail. The F.I.R. dated 09.08.2020, lodged by S.I. Josowanta Nath of Bhuragaon P.S. alleged that the petitioners are running the business of collecting jaggery of low quality and after mixing sugar, flour and colour, sales in the market at a high price affecting public health. A perusal of the case diary reveals that the investigating officer has seized huge quantity of articles such as sugar, inedible/adulterant jaggery, flour, artificial colour etc. from the house and premises of the petitioners. The report on the samples of the seized materials is yet to be received from the Commissioner, Food and Drug Administration, State Public Health Laboratory, Guwahati.
